input.title: Enforce custom agent subagent allowlists
input.body:
Custom agent `agents:` frontmatter was parsed and surfaced to the model, but `runSubagent` did not enforce it before dispatch. This allowed coordinator agents to invoke enabled agents outside their declared allowlist.

- **Allowlist enforcement**
  - Reject explicit `agentName` requests when the current agent has `allowedSubagents` and the requested agent is not listed.
  - Apply the check in both tool preparation and invocation paths.

- **Nested delegation scope**
  - Preserve the selected subagent’s own `agents:` frontmatter in nested `modeInstructions`.
  - Pass the active allowlist into automatic instruction collection so nested agents only see permitted subagents.

```ts
if (allowedSubagents && !allowedSubagents.includes('*') && !allowedSubagents.includes(subAgentName)) {
	throw new Error(`Requested agent '${subAgentName}' is not allowed by the current agent.`);
}
```
